description: Panels closed by the author with content-visibility: hidden and with hidden="until-found", on a page that also has a footer with content-visibility: auto. The footer is rendered for the scan, so its real list is read as a list; the closed panels are neither read nor rendered. Only the bulleted list after them is likely. e2e/lists.spec.ts checks that its box and its capture are those of the page as the author shows it.
